corrections.name: Bloody Sauce
corrections.character_source: Broly (Supervillain); Cell (Full Power) Supervillain; Golden Frieza (Supervillain); Yamcha (Supervillain)
corrections.reason: The dedicated Xenoverse 2 page lists Bloody Sauce as a Ki Blast Super, 100 Ki, with Expert Mission 20 as its unlock source and the listed Supervillain users. Batch 285 incorrectly attached it to Expert Mission 13.

corrections.name: Marbling Drop
corrections.reason: The Expert Mission list explicitly associates Marbling Drop (Raid) with Expert Mission 15, while current character documentation identifies Mira (Final Form) as a user. A dedicated current page was not found for a numeric Ki cost, so cost remains null.

corrections.name: Celestial Hammer
corrections.reason: The dedicated Xenoverse 2 page explicitly classifies Celestial Hammer as a Strike Super and Crystal Raid Skill. The character page confirms Fused Zamasu (Half-Corrupted) uses it and is Crystal Raid-exclusive.

notes: Batch 286 already contains the new Gigantic Slam record; this batch deliberately does not duplicate it. Corrections preserve the canonical Super/Ki Blast identity while changing only fields supported by stronger evidence.
